case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (arising out of Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 10798 Of 2022)
summary: Preventive detention under COFEPOSA; 60-day delay in considering representation; obligation of Central Government to act independently of Advisory Board; conflict between Pankaj Kumar Chakraborty and K.M. Abdulla Kunhi judgments on waiting for advisory opinion; illegible, Chinese-language detention grounds; procedural non-compliance in preventive detention; benefit of doubt to detenue; colonial legacy and potential for abuse of preventive detention laws.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned detention order set aside due to procedural infirmities and failure to provide legible grounds; benefit of doubt in favor of detenue.
